description: Fix the vessel routing in repos/goal-host-vessel/src/index.ts. In the routeFor helper, the final local-vessel branch calls asResolvePath on v.resolve_endpoint, which reduces an absolute URL to just its pathname, and then combines it with v.endpoint — so a vessel advertising a working absolute resolve_endpoint gets called at v.endpoint instead, which may be an unreachable host port. Change that final branch so that when v.resolve_endpoint is an absolute http:// or https:// URL, the route uses that URL's own origin as endpoint and its pathname plus search as resolvePath, instead of falling back to v.endpoint. Keep the existing behaviour unchanged when resolve_endpoint is relative or absent.
